Record Class PyronautCompiler.IncrementalCompilationPlan

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.python.compiler.PyronautCompiler.IncrementalCompilationPlan
Record Components:
upToDate - Whether no compilation is required
fullRebuild - Whether all current sources must be compiled
sources - The current source files selected for compilation
Enclosing class:
PyronautCompiler
public static record PyronautCompiler.IncrementalCompilationPlan(boolean upToDate, boolean fullRebuild, List<Path> sources) extends Record
Describes the source files selected by an incremental disk compilation.
